evidence.title: Laying the Foundation for the AI Era: Construction Begins on Hokkaido Tomakomai AI Data Center
evidence.excerpt: SoftBank says it and subsidiary IDC Frontier are constructing the Hokkaido Tomakomai AI Data Center and records an April 15, 2025 groundbreaking at the construction site.
